concerns.text: T007 authorizes 're-run T005 with --num_objects up to 20' on a failed power check, but FR-003 mandates 'exactly 10' novel objects. The revision note calls this 'the authorized escalation path' but no spec amendment authorizing it exists (the only proposed amendment covers the paired t-test). Either amend FR-003 or remove the escalation.

T009 verifies the ≤ 7 GB peak-memory budget (SC-004) 'via tracemalloc', which only tracks Python-level allocations and will miss PyBullet/torch C-level memory. The task's verification step cannot produce valid evidence for SC-004; use process RSS (resource.getrusage/psutil) instead.

T002 requires unit tests exercising stiction and non-clamped cases and outputs conforming to the schema, but the schema declares epsilon_clamped and is_valid with 'const: true', making any false-valued output schema-invalid. The task as written cannot both test variable flag behavior and pass contract validation; the schema (or the task's conformance claim) must be reconciled.

T010 hard-codes '≥ 15% improvement check for SC-001 and ≥ 10% for SC-002', but the SCs themselves are [deferred]. The numbers match the acceptance scenarios, but the PASS/FAIL conclusion flag in experiment_summary.json is evaluated against thresholds the spec never pins; state in T010 where the 15%/10% values are sourced (acceptance scenarios) or resolve the deferral.

Tasks write sweep rows to data/results/sweep.csv while the sweep schema description names data/generated/sweep.csv; T009's contract test and T012's documentation will disagree about the artifact location. Align the path.
